text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Inside the Mercurius Foundation guildhouse,
Akino and Tamaki kneel on the floor before Mifuyu.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ギルドハウスでアキノとタマキの二人は、
ミフユの前で正座させられていた。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Your wasteful spending is out of control!
That goes for both of you!
text_block_list.orig_text: 二人とも、浪費が激しすぎるっ！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
You, Miss Akino, have always been a reckless spender,
while you, Tamaki, are buying way, way too much cat food!
text_block_list.orig_text:
アキノさんはそもそもお金の使い方が荒いし、
タマキさんも猫のエサを大量に買いすぎ！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to come down on you too hard,
but if the two of you don't change your ways, we'll need
to dip into the funds reserved for investments and loans.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんまり厳しいことは言いたくないけど、
このままだと投資や融資に回す分のお金に
手を出さないといけなくなるのよ？

text_block_list.name: Akino
text_block_list.text:
Well, this is the only lifestyle I've ever known...
I hardly think I can change it now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私、
ずっとこういう生活しかしてこなかったんですの……
今更変えることなんてできませんわ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Myeah, and I just can't say no when I see
those cute little kitties begging me for food!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あたしも、
猫たちの
「エサくれー」って顔を見ると、
無視なんてできないにゃ……

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
No excuses!
For the time being, both of you can consider your wages cut!
text_block_list.orig_text:
言い訳は無駄っ！
とにかく、
当分二人の給料は減額します！

text_block_list.name: Akino
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*
Well this is certainly awful.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ……
困ったことになりましたわ……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Nyo kidding.
Without those rupies, all my little feline friends
are gonna go hungry.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まったくにゃ。
このままじゃ、
猫たちにエサもあげられないにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Akino
text_block_list.text: Oh? Isn't that...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら？　
あそこにいるのは？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Hey, {0}!
Over here! You gotta hear this!
Mifuyu's gone too far!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}！
おーい！　
聞いてほしいにゃ！
ミフユがひどいにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Akino
text_block_list.text:
She said we've been spending too much,
and slashed our wages by a hefty sum to compensate...
Oh, whatever are we going to do?
choice_data_list: Use the money you have left wisely.
Find another line of work to make more money?
text_block_list.orig_text:
お金を使いすぎだからと、
給料をこんなに減らされてしまいまして……
私たち、
これからどうすれば良いのでしょう？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Use our money wisely... Mya-ha!
That's it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
有効活用……
はっ！
そうにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Myake more money, eh?
I've got an idea!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お金を稼ぐ……！
いい手があるにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Nyice one, {0}!
If we're running short on funds, then we just have to find a way to myake what we have grow!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}のおかげでひらめいたにゃ！
お金が少ないなら、
自分たちで増やせばいいにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Akino
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's true, but...
How exactly are we going to do that?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それは、その通りですが……
どうやって増やしますの？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
I know the purr-fect place!
Follow me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いい所を知ってるにゃ！
ついてくるにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Akino
text_block_list.text: Should I be noticing something special about this restaurant?
text_block_list.orig_text: いつもの飲食店のようですが？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
The truth is, there’s some gambling going on in the back.
I’m paw-sitive we can rake in the rupies if we play!
text_block_list.orig_text:
実はこのお店で、
カードを使った賭け事をやってるにゃ。
参加すれば、
きっとお金を増やせるにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Akino
text_block_list.text:
A backroom gambling den, eh...
Are you sure this is all right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
裏で賭け事……
本当に大丈夫なんですの？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
It's only the customers playing together,
so there's nothing illegal about it!
The fact that I haven't busted it up is good proof of that!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お客同士で遊んでるだけだし、
犯罪ではないにゃ！
あたしが潰してないのが、
いい証拠にゃ！

text_block_list.name: Akino
text_block_list.text:
You do have a point. If everything weren't on the up-and-up, 
you certainly wouldn't vouch for it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
たしかに。
悪事を働く者がいれば、
タマキさんが紹介するはずありませんわね。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
That's right! So let's get this show on the road!
The game is five-card draw! I'll tell you everything 
you need to knyow, Akino. First, let's get you some cards.
text_block_list.orig_text:
というわけで、
さっそく参戦にゃ！
ここのルールはファイブカードドローだにゃ！
よく聞くにゃアキノ。
まずはカードを──

text_block_list.name: Akino
text_block_list.text: Full house. I win!
text_block_list.orig_text:
──フルハウス。
私の勝ちですわ。

text_block_list.name: Onlooker
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!
That girl's won the last ten hands in a row!
text_block_list.orig_text:
すげー！
あのお嬢ちゃん、
これで10連勝だぜ！？

text_block_list.name: Akino
text_block_list.text:
With my good fortune, winning at cards is child's play!
Deal the next hand!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私の強運があれば、
カードで勝つくらい簡単ですわ！
どんどん行きますわよ！

text_block_list.name: Opponent
text_block_list.text:
Heheheh... Three of a kind.
Sorry kiddo, looks like I win this time.
text_block_list.orig_text:
へっへっへ……
スリーカードだ。
残念だったな、
今度は俺の勝ちだ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Nyot so fast! This guy's a dirty cheat!
He switched his cards! 
You'll find the proof in his sleeve!
text_block_list.orig_text:
待つにゃ！　
こいつ、イカサマしたにゃ！
カードをすり替えたにゃ！
袖の中のカードが証拠にゃ！

text_block_list.name: Opponent
text_block_list.text:
D-dammit! 
How could you tell?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
く、
くそぉ！
なんでバレたんだ……！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Nyahaha! 
Nothing slips past this cat's eyes!
text_block_list.orig_text:
にゃっはっは！
あたしの目は誤魔化せないにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Akino
text_block_list.text:
The two of us together truly are unbeatable, Tamaki.
At this rate we'll never lose!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私とタマキさんが組めば、
最強ですわね。
負ける気がしませんわ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Myeah, that's right! Now it's time to really clean house!
text_block_list.orig_text:
この勢いで、
荒稼ぎにゃー！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: A few days later.
text_block_list.orig_text: 数日後──

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
That's odd.
I thought the two of them would be crawling back
sobbing for forgiveness by now...
text_block_list.orig_text:
おかしい……
さすがにそろそろ、二人が反省して
泣きついてくる頃だと思ったのに……

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
On the contrary, they seem to be in really high spirits lately.
Like they're really living it up...
text_block_list.orig_text:
むしろ、
最近すごく楽しそうじゃない？
生き生きしてるっていうか……？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: This isn't right... They're up to something.
text_block_list.orig_text:
怪しい……
何かありそうね。

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, {0}. We didn't ask you to come help us shop
just to fill your ears with this nonsense.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ごめんね。
{0}くんに買い物手伝わせといて、
こんな話まで聞いてもらっちゃって……

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
No, {0} is actually a key witness.
He's friends with Akino and Tamaki, too, after all.
That's why I asked him along today!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや、
{0}くんも重要な参考人よ。
アキノさんたちとも仲はいいし。
今日はそのために呼んだの！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: So, got any idea what those two are up to?
text_block_list.orig_text:
最近、
あの二人に何があったか知らない？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
They're making money by gambling?!
What a pair of absolute idiots!
text_block_list.orig_text:
賭け事で、お金を増やしてる！？
まったくあの二人は……！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Gambling is the bane of frugality!
Yukari, I need your help!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ギャンブルなんて節約の敵よ！
ユカリさん、
手伝って！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text: Sure, but with what...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいけど、
何をすればいいの……？

text_block_list.name: Akino
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! I win again!
At this point, even [i]I'm[/i] frightened
by how much fortune favors me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おーっほっほっほ！　
また私の勝ちですわ！
ここまで来ると、
自分の強運が恐ろしいですわね。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
And with me by your side, you'll nyever have to worry
about cheaters pulling one over on you!
We'll be laughing all the way to the bank!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あたしがついてる限り、
イカサマで負ける心配もないのにゃ！
稼ぎまくって、豪遊にゃー！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Miss Akino? Tamaki?
What're you doing here?
text_block_list.orig_text:
アキノさん？　
タマキさん？
何をしているの？

text_block_list.name: Akino
text_block_list.text:
Mifuyu?!
T-this is, well... It's not what it looks like!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミフユさん！？
こ、
これは、
その……
違うんですのよ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
No need to be a fraidy-cat, Akino!
We're nyot doing anything wrong, after all!
We can spend our own money however we please!
text_block_list.orig_text:
アキノ、落ち着くにゃ！
あたしたちは、悪いことなんてしてないにゃ！
自分のお金をどう使おうが、
あたしたちの勝手にゃ！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Maybe so, but gambling is out of the question.
Your father asked me to make sure you learn how to live
life in an honest, respectable manner.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だとしてもギャンブルは論外よ。
あなたのお父上からは、
堅実な生き方を
教えて欲しいって頼まれてるんだから。

text_block_list.name: Akino
text_block_list.text:
But, surely you can see we aren't losing?
I would have thought that our making all this extra money would please you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ですが私たち、
結果でみれば負けてませんわよ？
お金が増える分には、
ミフユさんとしても嬉しいのではなくて？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
I hear you two talking about all this money you're making,
and yet your coin purses seem a little light, don't they?
text_block_list.orig_text:
二人とも、
お金が増えてるって言うわりには、
サイフが薄いようだけど？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Y-yeah, well... 
We spend most of the money we make right away. 
That's just how it goes.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
それは……
儲かった分はすぐに使っちゃうから、
仕方ないにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
I slashed your pay so that you'd learn to spend your money
wisely. This undermines everything I'd hoped to teach you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
浪費癖を直すために給料を減らしたのよ？
それじゃ意味ないじゃない……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Grr... But this is money we won ourselves!
That means we can use it however we want!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぅ……
でも、
自分たちで勝ち取ったお金にゃ！
どう使おうと、
あたしたちの勝手にゃ！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
All right. I can see you're set in your ways.
So, how about Yukari and I take you on in a round of cards?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう……
よほど自信があるようね。
じゃあ、
私とユカリさんで組むから、
カードで勝負よ。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
I'll put all of my savings on the line. Here, I even wrote it up
in a contract. And as an added bonus, if you beat us
you can keep on gambling all you want.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私の貯金を全額かけてあげる。
誓約書を書いてきたわ。
ついでに、
私たちに勝ったらこれからも賭け事は続けていい。

text_block_list.name: Akino
text_block_list.text: That's, well, um... Are you sure that's okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それはまた……
いいんですの？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
In return, I want you to bet an equal sum.
And then if we win, you'll never, ever gamble again!
Got it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
その代わり、
そっちにも同じ額をかけてもらうわ。
そして私たちが勝ったら、
二度と賭け事はしないこと！
いいわね？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Nyow you're talkin’! We'll make you regret the day
you sat across the table from us!
text_block_list.orig_text:
望むところにゃ！
私たちに勝負を挑んだこと、
後悔させてやるにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Akino
text_block_list.text:
Two pair!
I'm afraid it was quite foolish of you
to pit yourselves against Tamaki and me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ツーペア！
私とタマキさんに勝とうなんて、
百年早いですわ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
We've got the early lead.
Nyow let's finish 'em off!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さっそくこっちが優勢だにゃ。
このままの勢いで勝っちゃうにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Customer 1
text_block_list.text: Woohoo! Go get 'em, Akino!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いよっ！　
さっすがアキノお嬢！

text_block_list.name: Customer 2
text_block_list.text: Take 'em for everything they've got!
text_block_list.orig_text: このまま有り金全部むしっちまえー！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Yukari. You still good to go?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ユカリさん。
まだいけるわよね？

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text: Yes. I'm fine.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ。
まだ大丈夫よ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Nyehehe...
Look like you've still got plenty of money on the table. ♪
Hey Akino, I think it's time to raise the bet!
text_block_list.orig_text:
にゃふふ……
有り金は十分あるみたいだにゃ♪
アキノ。
こうなったらもっと搾り取ってやるにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Akino
text_block_list.text: Agreed!
text_block_list.orig_text: 了解ですわ！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Full house.
text_block_list.orig_text: フルハウスよ。

text_block_list.name: Akino
text_block_list.text: One pair. And a fat lot of good it does me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ワンペアですわ……
なんのこれしき！

text_block_list.name: Customer 1
text_block_list.text: Hey, don't sweat it! The night's still young!
text_block_list.orig_text:
気にするな！　
こっからこっから！

text_block_list.name: Akino
text_block_list.text:
True. I've lost worse and still come back before.
This time things will end differently!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうですわ……
これくらいなら、
前にも逆転したことがあります。
今回だけは、
負けられません！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: A pair... I guess this means I win.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ワンペア……
これで勝負ありかしら？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hold up!
They've turned the tables on us somehow!
What gives?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや、
待つにゃ！
いっきに逆転されてくにゃ！？
どういうことにゃ！？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Straight flush.
I think it's safe to say we cleaned your clocks.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ストレートフラッシュよ。
……私たちの圧勝ってことでいいのよね？

text_block_list.name: Akino
text_block_list.text:
B-but how?
You've got us completely beaten!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ど、
どういうことですの……
私たちが手も足も出ないなんて！？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Simple. I memorized which cards were which
by looking at the scratches on their backs.
text_block_list.orig_text:
簡単な話よ。
カードの傷で、
すべての数字を暗記しておいたの。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Nyone of these cards are [i]that[/i] scratched up!
text_block_list.orig_text: カードにそんなわかりやすい傷はないはずにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Well, they're made of paper, so they tend to get nicked
with heavy use, right? See, like this mark here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
紙なんだから、
ちょっと雑に扱えば傷はつくでしょ？
ほら、
こことか。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
But that's nyothing!
You're saying you kept track of [i]that[/i] all through the game?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんなの細かすぎるにゃ！
これを勝負の最中に確認してたにゃ！？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Letting Yukari and I play on the same side
was a bad move, too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
もちろん。
それとユカリさんと私を一緒に戦わせたのは
まずかったわね。

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I know your mannerisms very well,
so I could read your faces and movements
to tell what you had in your hands.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私、
二人のクセはよく知ってるから、
表情や仕草でどんなカードを引いたか分かっちゃうの。

text_block_list.name: Akino
text_block_list.text: I never would've thought of that...
text_block_list.orig_text: そんな手があったなんて……

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Lastly, we had the audience on our side.
We paid for all of their drinks before they arrived.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あとは
周りの観客も全員協力者よ。
一人一人へ入店前に酒代を奢っておいたわ。

text_block_list.name: Akino
text_block_list.text: You did what?!
text_block_list.orig_text: なんですって！？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Nyo... something's still off.
I would've sniffed you out if you were cheating!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おかしいにゃ、
イカサマをしてたらあたしが気づくはずにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
We wanted you to win a bit and get overconfident,
so we had everyone egg you on. The two of you
let your guard down partway through, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなたたちをある程度のところまで気持ち良く勝たせるために、
一生懸命応援してもらったのよ。
二人とも、
途中から私たちを警戒しなくなったでしょう？

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
All the people here did was cheer you on
while having some free drinks and snacks.
It still proved pretty effective though, huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
つまり周りの人たちは、
タダで飲み食いして二人を応援しただけなの。
効果はばっちりだったでしょ？

text_block_list.name: Customer 2
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Yukari! Come drink for real next time, okay?
This was the first time I'd seen you sober like this in ages!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ユカリちゃん！　
今度はちゃんと飲みにきなよ！
素面のアンタを久々に見れたのは面白かったぜ！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text: Oh, haha. Sure, next time I'm in the mood.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あはは……
気が向いたらね。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
I-I've been had...
It wasn't quite cheating, so it slid completely under my nyose...
text_block_list.orig_text:
や、
やられたにゃ……
イカサマとは違うから、
見抜けなかったにゃ……

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
So, now that we've won,
I trust you remember your part of the deal?
text_block_list.orig_text:
さて……
私たちの勝ちということは──
約束は覚えているわね？

text_block_list.name: Akino
text_block_list.text:
Fine.
We will never, ever, dabble in games of chance again.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
わかりましたわ。
賭け事は二度と、
やりませんわ。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you forgetting something?
We wagered all of our savings, remember?
That means the two of you lost more money than you have.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それだけじゃなかったはずよね？
私たちは貯金全額をかけたのよ？
つまりあなたたちは手持ちの額以上に負けたってこと。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
This is quite a sum. Think your wages will cover it?
If not, I guess you'll have to take out a couple of loans. ♪
And as it happens, our guild is in the money lending business.
text_block_list.orig_text:
けっこうな金額だけど……
二人の給料で払えるかしら？
払えないなら、
借金してでも払ってもらうから♪
そういえば私たちのギルド、
お金を貸してるんだけど……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Nyoooo, nyot a loan! Anything but thaaat!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんにゃああああ！　
借金だけはイヤにゃあああああ……！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: The next day—
text_block_list.orig_text: 翌日──

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: I-I finished the job...
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
お仕事終わったにゃ……

text_block_list.name: Akino
text_block_list.text: Well, the paperwork is complete.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……書類の作成、
終わりましたわ。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Okay, next I want you to clean the office.
And after that, I've got some new business plans
I need your help with.
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ次は部屋の掃除をお願い。
その後は新しい事業の計画書を仕上げるから手伝って。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Oof... This is overkill!
Down with unfair labor practices!
We have rights, too, you knyow!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぅ……
さすがに働かせすぎにゃ！
不当労働反対にゃ！　
あたしたちにも権利をー！

text_block_list.name: Akino
text_block_list.text: I fail to understand why we must be oppressed so!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なぜ私たちが、
ここまで虐げられるのですか……！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
I'd work more and complain less if I were you, 
otherwise you'll never get out of the hole. Don't forget
your pay was reduced even more as punishment for gambling.
text_block_list.orig_text:
たくさん働かないと、
ギルドへの借金は返済できないんじゃない？
賭け事した罰として、
給料はもっと減っちゃったわけだし。

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
And it's true that we're a bit shorthanded 
now that our guild has grown. I'm finishing up early today,
so I'll leave the rest to you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ギルドも大きくなってきたから、
人手が足りないのは本当なの。
ごめんなさい二人とも、
今日は先に上がるから後はお願いね。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for your help, Yukari.
Until you've paid what you owe, I'm the acting guildmaster!
C'mon, let's pick up the pace! Time is money!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お疲れ様、
ユカリさん。
……全額返済するまでは、
私がギルドマスター代理よ！
ほら、
キリキリ働く！　
時は金なりよ！

text_block_list.name: Akino
text_block_list.text:
*huff, huff*
I'm never, [i]ever[/i], touching a deck of cards again!
text_block_list.orig_text:
も……
もう賭け事なんて
こりごりですわー！！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Myaaargh, I hate being in debt!
text_block_list.orig_text: 借金なんて大嫌いにゃあああ……！！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
And so it was that Akino and Tamaki
swore in their hearts to never gamble ever again.
text_block_list.orig_text:
二度と賭け事なんてやらないと、
心に誓うアキノとタマキであった。
